final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id), stats AS (SELECT AVG(address_count) AS avg_addresses_per_city, SUM(address_count) AS total_addresses FROM city_counts) SELECT cc.city_id, cc.address_count, 1.0 * cc.address_count / s.avg_addresses_per_city AS count_divided_by_average, 1.0 * cc.address_count / s.total_addresses AS share_of_addresses FROM city_counts AS cc CROSS JOIN stats AS s ORDER BY share_of_addresses DESC LIMIT 10
